# Evidence of Life — llms-full.txt
# Expanded agent index. Keep facts aligned with the repository; do not fabricate APIs.

## Product
Evidence of Life (evidenceoflife-v2) is a full-stack personal life management app:
plan the day on a timeline, run focus timers, capture moments (notes/photos/places/tags),
track dues and habits, browse calendar/year/map views, optionally sync Google Calendar.
Synthetic public demo: `/demo-app` (no real Supabase required for UI smoke).

Positioning: private memory / planned-vs-actual execution. Not medical therapy.

## Runtime commands
```
npm install
cp .env.example .env   # VITE_SUPABASE_URL + VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY for real data
npm run dev            # http://localhost:8080
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run lint
npm run test:e2e
npm run test:security  # needs Deno
npm run build
```

## Frontend map

### Pages (`src/pages/`)
| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| Landing.tsx | Marketing + embedded demo frame |
| Auth.tsx / AuthCallback.tsx | Supabase auth UI + OAuth callback |
| Index.tsx | Main authenticated app shell (tabs) |
| PublicDemo.tsx | Forces demo user + English + Index publicDemo |
| NotFound.tsx | 404 |

### Views (`src/components/views/`)
| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| PlanView.tsx | Plan list / segments / capture |
| PlanTimelineView.tsx | Day timeline blocks |
| TodayView.tsx | Today modes + recap |
| CalendarView.tsx / LifeCalendar.tsx | Calendar + year grid |
| MapView.tsx | Leaflet map of places |
| DuesView.tsx / HabitsView.tsx | Dues + habits |
| StickyNotesView.tsx | Sticky notes |
| LinksView.tsx | Link hub |
| ProfileView.tsx | Settings / profile |
| ICSImportManager.tsx | ICS import helper |

### Hooks (`src/hooks/`)
Auth: useAuth.tsx  
Data: useTodos, useMoments, useDues, useDueReminders, usePlaces, useLinks, useStickyNotes, useImportedEvents, useGoogleCalendar, useProfile, useReminders, useLifeReminder (browser + optional ntfy)  
UX: useLanguage, useTheme, useAccentColor, useSpeechRecognition, useSpotlight  

### Lib highlights (`src/lib/`)
momentPhotos.ts — upload path + signed URL resolve  
ntfy.ts — optional ntfy.sh / self-hosted push for life reminders  
autoSchedule.ts / freeRegions.ts / recurringTodos.ts / carryTodos.ts — planning math  
exportEvidence.ts — user data export  
analytics.ts — optional GA4 / Amplitude  
linkUtils.ts — URL normalize + image-proxy URL builder  

## Backend map

### Migrations
`supabase/migrations/` — schema, RLS, storage policies. Latest hardening includes private `moment-photos` and service-role-only `google_calendar_tokens` writes.

### Edge functions
| Function | Auth model | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| geo | user JWT | Nominatim proxy / place classify |
| smart-input | user JWT | optional AI classify |
| link-preview | user JWT | OG / site preview |
| image-proxy | anon apikey + origin allowlist | fetch remote images for cards |
| life-replay | user JWT | optional AI day narrative |
| google-calendar-auth | user JWT | start OAuth; HMAC state |
| google-calendar-callback | signed state | token exchange; allowlisted redirect |
| google-calendar-sync | user JWT | import events |

Shared helpers: `supabase/functions/_shared/auth.ts` (+ `auth.test.ts`).

## Security boundaries (do not weaken casually)
- Browser: anon key + user JWT only
- Photos: private bucket; paths in DB; short-lived signed URLs for display
- Calendar tokens: written by service role in edge functions only
- OAuth state: HMAC + expiry + redirect origin allowlist
- See docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md

## Test layout
- Unit: `src/test/*.test.ts` (Vitest)
- E2E smoke: `e2e/demo-smoke.spec.ts` (Playwright, injects dummy VITE_* in config)
- Deno: `supabase/functions/_shared/auth.test.ts`

## CI
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` — lint, typecheck, unit tests, build, security-tests, e2e  
Also: codeql.yml, secret-scan.yml (gitleaks), dependabot.yml
